BatchChatRequest.title: BatchChatRequest
BatchChatRequest.description:
V8 batch endpoint. The gateway dispatches the inner calls with
bounded parallelism so providers' rate limits are respected centrally.

BudgetSetRequest.title: BudgetSetRequest
BudgetSetRequest.description:
POST /v1/budget — arm or move a ceiling at runtime.

`principal` is "<dimension>:<value-or-glob>" over the five attribution
dimensions (tenant, project, user, agent, session). A runtime entry shadows
a same-named entry in budgets.yaml, so an operator can clamp a runaway
session without a deploy, and `limit_usd: 0` refuses everything for that
principal immediately.

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest
ChatRequest.description: Backward-compatible request — every new field is optional.

EmbedRequest.title: EmbedRequest
EmbedRequest.description:
Request for POST /v1/embed. The model is fixed per deployment (see
README); only the text, task type, and an optional explicit provider
are caller-controlled.

PhotoPassageBody.title: PhotoPassageBody
PhotoPassageBody.description:
One OCR'd passage box on the source page, for the read-only overlay
shown alongside a proposal review. The pipeline does not track which
specific passage backs a given proposal's evidence quote, so every
passage on the page is offered -- a reviewer locates their highlight
among them visually, the same way ImageReview.tsx already does.

RunReportBody.title: RunReportBody
RunReportBody.description:
The durable record a finished run leaves behind.

This is the report's own ``data`` mapping. The on-disk path is deliberately
not exposed: it is a server filesystem detail, not a fact about the run.

SiblingProposalBody.title: SiblingProposalBody
SiblingProposalBody.description:
A read-only preview of another proposal from the same envelope.

Lets the shell show every proposal derived from one highlight on a single
screen without re-fetching or re-rendering the shared highlight/evidence
context per proposal. Each sibling is still decided through its own
`/run/decision` call once it becomes the active `proposal_id` -- this is
a display aid, not a bulk-decision channel.

ToolDef.title: ToolDef
ToolDef.description: Canonical tool definition. Schema is JSON-Schema (typically from Pydantic).

VisionRequest.title: VisionRequest
VisionRequest.description:
V9: typed shim for single-image vision calls. Lower-ceremony than
/v1/chat for the set-of-marks loop — callers send one image, one prompt,
and (optionally) a JSON schema for typed output, and the gateway forces
routing to a vision-capable provider.

Accepts either a data: URL (base64) or an http(s) URL for `image`.
The gateway pre-resolves http URLs the same way /v1/chat does.
